theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_pf_pushforward_mass_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (L : ℝ) (Y Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ y ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ L) → R.Represents Y → IsCompact Y.support → Y.support ⊆ O → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Z ω = ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[n]) → Z.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (L ^ n) * Y.mass
